transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm really confused and scared because I keep hearing voices and seeing things that other people tell me aren't actually there. This has been happening to me for about four months now, and it's getting really hard to handle.
Along with these voices and visions, have you been experiencing any major changes in your mood, such as feeling very down and depressed, or unusually energetic and high?
No, I haven't really had any extreme mood changes like that. I don't feel deeply depressed or unusually energetic. It's mostly just the voices and seeing things that are troubling me.
Besides the voices and visions, do you hold any strong beliefs or fears that others tell you are not true, such as feeling that you are being watched or plotted against?
No, I don't have any beliefs or fears like that. I've never felt like I was being watched or plotted against by anyone. My main struggles are really just the voices and the visions.
Have you noticed any changes in your motivation to do daily activities, or have you found yourself withdrawing from friends and family lately?
No, I haven't really noticed any major changes in my motivation. I'm still trying to do my normal daily activities and haven't really withdrawn from my friends or family.
Have you or others noticed any changes in how you organize your thoughts, or has your speech ever become confused or difficult for others to follow?
I haven't really noticed any issues with organizing my thoughts or having confused speech. As far as I know, others haven't mentioned anything like that to me either.
Have you been using any recreational drugs, alcohol, or new medications around the time these voices and visions started?
No, I don't use any recreational drugs or drink alcohol. I also haven't started taking any new medications around that time.
Have you recently been diagnosed with any medical conditions, or have you experienced any physical illnesses or head injuries?
No, I haven't been diagnosed with any medical conditions or had any physical illnesses lately. I also haven't had any head injuries or accidents.
Have these experiences of hearing and seeing things made it difficult for you to work, study, or manage your relationships with others?

I'm not really sure how it's affected those parts of my life. I haven't really thought about how it impacts my work or relationships because I've just been so focused on dealing with the voices and visions.
Did these voices and visions start suddenly four months ago, or did you notice any other changes in your behavior, sleep, or personality before they began?

The voices and visions themselves started about four months ago. However, I actually started noticing other changes in my behavior and personality much earlier, about a year and a month ago. That was about nine months before the hallucinations even began.
Could you tell me more about those changes in your behavior and personality that started over a year ago, before the voices and visions began?

I'm not really sure how to describe those earlier changes, and I can't quite recall the specific details of what was happening. I just know that I've felt different and not quite like myself for a little over a year now.
